launch_slurm_job: submit a FairChem job to a SLURM cluster using submitit AutoExecutor with configurable nodes and GPUs
launch_local_job: launch a FairChem job locally using torch elastic launch for multi-worker or single-process execution
run_slurm_spmd_program: run a single-program-multiple-data SPMD program on SLURM with distributed setup, seeding, and checkpointing support
map_job_config_to_dist_config: convert a FairChem JobConfig into a distributed training config dict with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a submitted SLURM job from its runner state to prevent stale state resubmission on node failure
